headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into the red while Nifty gained 75 points amidst mixed market cues.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following afternoon volatility and profit booking.
Nifty managed to hold gains of 75 points supported by selective buying.
Global market sentiment was cautious due to hawkish Fed signals and global economic warnings.
Investors monitored key support levels as Nifty approached the 23,000 mark.
whatHappening: Traders are evaluating whether Nifty can defend the crucial 23,000 support zone in the coming week.
Paytm remained under intense investor spotlight following recent developments.
Banking stocks are being tracked closely as analysts highlight potential for sector re-rating.
Government proposals to bear UPI network maintenance costs provided relief to financial services.

summary: On the last trading day, the Nifty gained 75 points while the Sensex ended slightly in the red due to late-session selling. Markets are closed today, 19 September 2026, for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 21 September. All eyes remain on whether the Nifty can hold its crucial 23,000 support level.
